name: code_terraform
_doc: What the stand-ins know about THIS repo's scripts (scripts/4_controlpanel). Game facts (machine types, slot ids, state shapes) stay in standins.mjs; everything that depends on how a script set names its archive keys lives here. docs/headless/standins.md 'Profile'. --script-set none runs a foreign script set without any of it.

stubs._doc: Keys a group's scripts would have published, written once when the group is off (a key the scenario's archive section seeds is left to the seed). Readers verified 2026-10-14 (lib/power.py, wildlife_common.py, biomass_retire.py): an empty shed list and an empty plan mean 'nothing shed / no plan' everywhere.

budget._doc: Orchestrator off: refresh this record every 100 ticks. lib/cash.py: a cash.budget older than MANAGER_STALE_TICKS makes every capital can_spend() keep LEGACY_RESERVE (100,000 cr); asks and holds age out after askStaleTicks / holdTicks.

requests._doc: The logistics request protocol the mover serves (lib/logistics_requests.py, priority.py): requests {dest: {item: {levels: [[prio, cum], ...], have, by, tick, buy?, keep?}}}, pickups {key: {vehicle, dest, source, item_id, units, tick, aboard}}.

sweep._doc: Left-over sweep defaults for this script set (docs/headless/standins.md 'Left-overs'). fields: record fields that name the writer; skipKeys: keys never swept. script.parked stays: lib/script_parking.py treats a machine that is neither running nor parked as stray dark (warns every pass, switches it on after 3000 ticks); a stopped script that keeps its parked entry reads as parked, which is the nearer truth, and the revival guard covers the sunrise restart of parked solar scripts (phase 14 A/B: 80 stray warnings per hour without this).
